## Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download this |
|---|---|
| **Mac with Apple Silicon** (M1, M2, M3, M4 or newer) | `Study-Coach-…-Mac-Apple-Silicon.dmg` |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** (most Macs from before 2021) | `Study-Coach-…-Mac-Intel.dmg` |
| **Windows 10 or 11** | `Study-Coach-…-Windows-Setup.exe` |

**Not sure which Mac you have?** Click the Apple menu  (top-left of your screen) → **About This Mac**.
If it says **Chip: Apple M…**, download **Mac-Apple-Silicon**. If it says **Processor: … Intel …**, download **Mac-Intel**.

Everything Study Coach needs is included, including the tools that read PDFs and scanned pages. You don't need to install anything else.
It runs on macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer, and Windows 10 or 11.
AI is optional: see the [guide to setting up AI](https://github.com/curyantony-code/study-coach-oss/blob/main/docs/ai-setup/README.md) (there's a free option).

**First time opening it:** the app isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so your computer will ask you to confirm. See [how to open it](https://github.com/curyantony-code/study-coach-oss#download-and-install).
